response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT arcref, cnt AS qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM s ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Projects are those appearing in scanqc.arcref (projects with no QC records are excluded from the total and from the average share).
Ties in deviation are broken arbitrarily since no tiebreaker was specified; no NULL arcref exists since the column is NOT NULL.
